parts:
Issue 5: No autoregressive terms in the regimes for setar() and TVAR()
http://code.google.com/p/tsdyn/issues/detail?id=5

Comment #2 by Matthieu.Stigler:
Revision 214 allows now to set ML, MH, or MM=0 (only if the include arr
is "none").

Try:
setar(lynx, mL=1,mH=3,MM=0, nthresh=2)
setar(lynx, mL=2, MH=0)

The implementation relyes on two new internal functions:
#gets a vector with names of the arg inc
getIncNames<-function(inc,ML){
ninc<-length(inc)
letter<-deparse(substitute(ML))
letter<-sub("M","",letter)
paste(inc, rep(letter,ninc))
}

#get a vector with names of the coefficients
getArNames<-function(ML){
if(any(ML==0))
return(NA)
else{
letter<-deparse(substitute(ML))
letter<-sub("M","",letter)
paste(paste("phi",letter, sep=""),".", ML, sep="")
}
}

The naming of the variable have been changed (so also the args function
getSetarXRegimeCoefs) rom phi1/phi2 to phiL/phiH. This can be reverted
without problem.
